title: 第23章 在下截教大师兄收通臂猿猴袁洪获金刚不坏降龙伏虎第24章 代师收徒梅山七义入截教九息服气白虹贯日
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 别打了！”
“饶命啊六位爷，小的真的不知道他只是单纯来摘梅花的……”
崩塌碎裂的梅山里。
传来高明高觉两精哀嚎痛叫。
原来是回过神来的袁洪、金大升六人恼羞成怒，提起拳头二话不说便朝两精怪打去，打得树叶树枝掉落一地，都不带停手的。
看到这一幕。
青渊内心有些说不出的感慨。
洪荒生灵天生地养，没有什么价值观和规矩束缚，再加上绝大多数生灵都是埋头苦修，头脑简单四肢发达脾气火爆，很容易因误会导致灾难发生，因为一点小事最终闹成不死不休的局面。
一旦量劫到来。
劫气蒙尘，死亡率更高！
例如他所在的截教。
不就是申公豹一句‘道友请留步’，一点点的从外门弟子拉人，后面导致圣人都下场打碎洪荒了吗？
谁能想得到，瓦解庞然大物的不是上层建筑。
而是来自下层呢？
而这，便是青渊大费周章弄巡检司的原因。
他想要截教内形成一种规矩和价值观，让所有进入截教的生灵都被这股观念束缚，让其遵纪守法些，也免得来日死在量劫当中。
截教那群弟子。
比梅山七怪这些家伙还要头铁鲁莽的人才，大有人在啊！
谁见过敢在圣人讲道时现场拉屎的？
谁见过敢在圣人道场附近交媾的？
这些场面，看的青渊头皮发麻，可奈何只要不是冲师逆徒，师父通天根本不管，只教大道不束缚门人，使得这些本就天地精怪、妖魔野兽得道的记名弟子愈发桀骜狂妄。
正当青渊沉思。
六妖仙也教训完了高明高觉。
满脸惭愧的朝青渊躬身行礼道歉起来。
“是我等鲁莽了，多谢前辈饶命之恩，多谢前辈！”
“无妨，一点小误会罢了。”
青渊笑着挥手将六妖扶了起来，也道歉道：“是我看见这片梅山秀丽，忍不住下来采摘些梅花回去泡酒，不知此处有主人，不请自来我也有错。”
“前辈心胸宽广，真乃福德清真道君也！”
“方才我看前辈一表人才、威风凛凛，怎么也不像是坏人，就怪高明高觉两个家伙胡乱说话，害我们跟前辈起了冲突！”
“就是，两个蠢货，前辈摘点梅子怎么了？就算是把梅山搬空了，我金大升也没有一句怨言……”
见青渊如此豪迈洒脱。
六妖仙内心敬佩，连忙将他请入道场里摆下宴席招待。
待酒过三巡。
袁洪方才好奇问道：“喝了这么久的梅子酒，不知前辈尊姓大名？”
话落。
其余五妖也露出好奇目光，炯炯有神的注视青渊。
“我叫青渊，乃上清灵宝天尊通天教主所创截教内门大弟子，见过诸位道友了！”
青渊笑着朝六妖抱拳。
content_en:
"Ah!
Stop it! "
"Have mercy on you, Master Six. I really don't know that he is just here to pick plum blossoms..."
In the collapsed plum mountain.
Gao Ming and Gao Jue were heard wailing and screaming in pain.
It turned out that the six people, Yuan Hong and Jin Dasheng, who had recovered their senses, became so angry that they raised their fists and hit the two spirits without saying a word. They did not stop until the leaves and branches fell to the ground.
See this scene.
Qingyuan felt some unspeakable emotions in his heart.
Alas...
Creatures in the primitive world are born with no values or rules. In addition, most of the creatures are immersed in hard work, with simple minds and strong limbs and hot tempers. It is easy for misunderstandings to lead to disasters, because a small matter will eventually lead to an endless situation.
Once the calamity comes.
The calamity is covered in dust, and the mortality rate is even higher!
For example, the Jiejiao where he is located.
Isn't it just that Shen Gongbao said, "Fellow Taoist, please stay" and gradually attracted people from the outer disciples, which eventually led to the end of the saints and the destruction of the prehistoric world?
Who would have thought that it was not the superstructure that disintegrated the behemoth.
But from below?
And this is the reason why Qingyuan spent so much time on the inspection department.
He wanted to form a kind of rules and values ​​within the Jie Sect, so that all the creatures who entered the Jie Sect would be bound by this concept, so that they would abide by the law and avoid dying in calamity in the future.
Jie taught those disciples.
There are many talented people who are more stubborn and reckless than the Seven Monsters of Meishan!
Who has seen anyone dare to poop while a saint is preaching?
Who has ever seen anyone dare to have sex near a saint’s ashram?
Seeing these scenes, Qingyuan's scalp was numb, but as long as he did not rebel against his master, Master Tongtian didn't care at all. He only taught the Tao and did not restrain his disciples, making these registered disciples who were already masters of the world's spirits, monsters and beasts even more unruly and arrogant.
While Qingyuan was deep in thought.
The Six Demon Immortals also finished teaching Gao Ming and Gao Jue.
With a face full of shame, he bowed to Qingyuan and apologized.
"I was the one who was reckless. Thank you, senior, for sparing your life. Thank you, senior!"
"It's okay, it's just a small misunderstanding."
Qingyuan smiled and waved his hand to help the six demons up, and also apologized: "I saw the beauty of this plum mountain, so I couldn't help but come down to pick some plum blossoms to make wine. I didn't know there was an owner here, so it was my fault to come here uninvited."
"Senior has a broad mind and is truly a blessed and pure Taoist master!"
"Just now, I saw that senior looked talented and majestic, and he didn't look like a bad person at all. It's just because Gao Ming and Gao Jue talked nonsense that caused us to have a conflict with senior!"
"It's just, two idiots, what happened to senior picking some plums? Even if the plum mountain is emptied, I, Jin Dasheng, won't have a single complaint..."
See Qingyuan so bold and free and easy.
The Six Demon Immortals admired him deeply and quickly invited him into the dojo and held a banquet in his honor.
Wait for three rounds of wine.
Yuan Hong just curiously asked: "You have been drinking plum wine for so long. Do you know your senior's surname?"
The words fell.
The other five demons also showed curious eyes and stared at Qing Yuan with keen attention.
"My name is Qing Yuan, and I am a disciple of the inner sect of the Jie sect founded by the leader of Shangqing Lingbao Tianzun Tongtian. I have met all of you fellow Taoists!"
Qing Yuan smiled and cupped his fists at the Six Demons.
title_en: Chapter 23: The senior brother of the Jie Jiao teaches Yuan Hong, the arm ape and the monkey, and obtains the indestructible Vajra, subdues the dragon and subdues the tiger. Chapter 24: Accepts the apprentice Meishan Qiyi as the master and enters the Jie Jiao.
